definitions.content:
name: github_activity_change_wow
label: GitHub activity, change on the same weekday a week earlier
description: Metrics 4 and 6. A day's count against the same weekday 7 days earlier, in percent, per activity.
  Group by metric_time__day and github_day__activity (filter github_day__weekday_name = 'Thursday' for
  the Thursdays around release day). NULL when either day is missing.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_activity_wow_pct_change

name: github_activity_count_week_before
label: GitHub activity, same weekday a week earlier
description: Metrics 4 and 6. The count on the same weekday 7 days earlier, per activity. Group by metric_time__day
  and github_day__activity.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_activity_prior_week_count
